changes.title: ARCANA
added: *Global Update: It does not matter what card you feed into another, all of the experience is now the same for Global. You do NOT get bonus experience for feeding the same exact card and card type. All experience is transferred 1:1 (so if you feed a card into another…then feed that fed card into another, all the exp will transfer over)

TOP WINGS FOR EACH CLASS (KR as of 10/22/2026)

A: Frontal/Back Attack Damage Boost is a newer stat that was introduced and it is in its own multiplicative damage bucket. Due to the nature of Front/Back Damage Boost being a very high value damage stat, ranged classes have begun to incorporate it into their builds despite having less access to the stat compared to melee positional classes. NC has even confirmed that all but Assassins are attacking from the front. There is a good chance that this gets adjusted with most players in KR thinking they may add some kind of Elemental Damage Boost stat.

changes.title: HOW STATS WORK (DAMAGE FORMULA)
added: Additional Notes: Combat Speed is a given S-tier individual stat that you stack as much as you can. This, however, is directly impacted by ping and FPS. When tested, a difference of 150-200 ping equated to roughly ≈ 15% ~ 20% damage. Contrary to popular belief, there were no major differences between classes. Templar, Brawler, and Assassin were the three classes tested and were roughly similar. Spiritmaster may be an outlier due to the passive pet damage.
